title: Lattes CV Editing for Academic Records
description: A ScholarSkills package (SS-0013) that prepares and checks items before they are typed into a Lattes CV: required fields per record type, duplicate detection by normalised title and year, the rule that preprint and published article are distinct records, and a written approval gate before submission.
